title: Ordinary ringed-site evaluation formulas and augmentation comparison models
statement: Let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology on a category with object universe $c$ and arrow universe $v$, and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings with rings and module sheaves in universe $\max(c,v,u)$ [def-weil-size-convention] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume sheafification and that local bijectivity characterizes the associated sheaf equivalences in this universe. Use the actual Hom complex and sheaf Hom [def-pur-hom-complex] [def-pur-sheaf-hom], the coefficient unit complex $O=R[0]$, and the actual total tensor and sheafified pure-tensor generators [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. For complexes $E,F$, define $\operatorname{homValue}_{E,F}^{n,a,b}(\phi,x)$, for $a+n=b$, by applying the actual $(a,b)$ Hom-product projection to $\phi\in\mathcal Hom^n(E,F)(U)$ and evaluating at $x\in E^a(U)$ at the identity object of the localized site over $U$. For $\phi\in\mathcal Hom^q(E,O)(U)$ and $a+q=0$, define $\operatorname{dualValue}_E^{q,a}(\phi,x)\in R(U)$ by this evaluation followed by the degree-zero coefficient-unit identification. Define $\operatorname{EvaluationFormula}(a_{E,F})$ for a chain map $a_{E,F}:\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,O))\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,F)$ to mean the following: for every $p,q,n,a,b$ with $p+q=n$, $a+n=b$, every $U$, $y\in F^p(U)$, $\phi\in\mathcal Hom^q(E,O)(U)$ and $x\in E^a(U)$, its Hom value on the $(p,q)$ pure-tensor generator $y\otimes\phi$ equals $\operatorname{dualValue}_E^{q,a}(\phi,x)\,y$ transported from degree $p$ to degree $b$ when $a+q=0$, and is zero when $a+q\ne0$. This formula has no additional Koszul sign. Use the fixed functorial K-injective replacement $I$ and augmentation $\eta$ of the derived-Hom representative model [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation]. Define the ordinary Hom augmentation map to be $\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,\eta_G):\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,G)\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,I(G))$. If the module category has its derived localization $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define the ordinary-to-derived Hom comparison $Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,G)\to R\mathcal Hom(QE,QG)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] as $Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,\eta_G)$ followed by the inverse of the fixed localization factorization isomorphism. All maps and evaluations are the recorded constructions, with no new choices.
